title: 3.3.1.2 Continual Bluetooth Pairing Requests
symptom: After upgrading from 3.3.1.0 to 3.3.1.2, the user receives a series of 3 Bluetooth pairing requests each time AAPS connects to the Omnipod Dash pod. Accepting the pairing request breaks connectivity between AAPS and the pod, and the phone is flooded with pairing requests every few minutes.
cause: The issue is specific to AndroidAPS 3.3.1.2 and Android 15, as rolling back to 3.3.1.0 resolves the problem. A maintainer suggests reverting a change for Dash in the Master branch or making it an option defaulted off.
fix: Roll back to AndroidAPS 3.3.1.0 to avoid the Bluetooth pairing requests. A maintainer suggests reverting the change for Dash in the Master branch or making it an option in Dash settings defaulted off.
evidence_quote: I've confirmed it's 3.3.3.2 specific as I've rolled back to 3.3.1.0 and the Bluetooth prompts went away.
